reviews.feedback: internal/store/types.go:251-252: PreviousSecret and SecretRotatedAt are tagged json:"-", but internal/snapshot/snapshot.go:30 persists the store as JSON through State (internal/store/state.go:22, Export at :63-65, FromState at :175-180). After a restart, endpoints rotated within the last 24 hours lose their previous secret and rotation time, so deliveries stop carrying the previous secret's v1 entry, breaking the 24-hour requirement. Do not just change the tag: the endpoint API serializes the same struct, so a json tag would leak the previous secret. Persist the rotation state through a separate field in State (filled in Export, restored in FromState) and keep it out of the API JSON. Add a test that round-trips the store through Export/FromState and checks SigningSecrets still returns the previous secret inside the 24-hour window and drops it after.
